limitations: Augmented and safety profiles are built from catalog units in TSP's certificate shape, not from real learners; augmented labels are the team-written goal labels (engineering draft).
Certificates are never labels of what a learner wants: augmented keeps the skill's answers, and the real held-out label only asks whether evidence points back to a qualification the learner did earn.
No threshold was tuned; every system uses the parameters the model gets in the API.
Not evidence of production readiness: that needs assessor-labeled real profiles (evaluation.labeling).
